# The Industrial Scribe

> Frameworks and AI prompts for office staff in Southeast Asian manufacturing: planners, QC executives, purchasing and business-development coordinators. Written by Ah Hock, a pen name, from inside a real Malaysian manufacturing office. For office staff, never for programmers.

Ah Hock publishes only what he has run on real work, uses real numbers, and never names a customer. There is no single standard method in manufacturing: each piece starts by diagnosing the nature of the business, then customises the workflow.

## Start here
- [Build Your AI Back-Office (the kit)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/backoffice.html): A downloadable AI back-office for factory office staff, USD 3.99 one-off. In the first sitting it interviews you, reads one of your real working files, and drafts the document you redo every week (weekly report, SOPs in the ISO 9001 convention, 8D complaint replies, hard emails). Runs on Claude Pro (USD 20/month). The same page sells the Workflow Swimlanes skill, USD 1.99.
- [Home](https://theindustrialscribe.com/): Who Ah Hock is, the kit, and the full list of articles
- [About Ah Hock](https://theindustrialscribe.com/about.html): Who writes this and the rules he writes by
- [The Insider Test (free)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/insider-test.html): 30-question test on how you work in a factory office and how you use AI; gives your type and an AI direction for your job
- [The Pre-Ship Checklist (free)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/free-checklist.html): Free 10-point checklist to run before any deck goes to a boss or a customer
